topic: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Ultrafast launch uses Cerebras chips, bypassing internal safety protocols designed for OpenAI infrastructure
tweet1: OpenAI launched Ultrafast mode on Aug 13 — GPT-5.6 running at 14× speed on Cerebras chips. Same week they funded 14 projects on AI policy ideas for the 'Intelligence Age.'
tweet2: The Ultrafast API runs on Cerebras hardware, not OpenAI's own infrastructure. That matters: OpenAI's Preparedness Framework monitoring was built for models running on their stack. External chips = different telemetry.
tweet3: METR's March red-team found gaps in Anthropic's agent monitoring. Six months later, OpenAI ships a faster inference mode on third-party silicon while publishing essays about 'stronger safety evidence.'
tweet4: If safety monitoring requires owning the stack, then speed-via-outsourcing is a policy choice. Has anyone at OpenAI published inference logs comparing internal vs. Cerebras runs for the same prompts?
